SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
GROUP BY
    p.product_id,
    p.category
ORDER BY
    units_sold DESC,
    p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
        ('EUR', 0.0108::DECIMAL),
        ('JPY', 0.0067::DECIMAL)
    ) AS t(currency, usd_factor)
)
SELECT COALESCE(
           SUM(
               oi.qty
               * oi.unit_price_minor
               * cf.usd_factor
           ),
           0
       ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM order_items oi
JOIN eligible_orders eo
  ON eo.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p
